pageCache.text:
Key Info
An Introduction to our Governors
The governors of Jessie Younghusband School are very keen supporters of everything the school undertakes and achieves. They work closely with the Headteacher to make decisions about the curriculum, finance, Staffing, and the school's buildings. Governors ensure that the school provides the best possible primary educationfor its pupils.
They help form the school's aims and policies and act as a link between the local community and the school. They try to join in with the life and work of the school by visiting classes to meet the children, attend assemblies, staff meetings and other social events to meet the parents.
The Governing Body of Jessie Younghusband School
The Governing Body of the school is made up of people from a variety of backgrounds, including parent governors. Other groups represent the Local Authority, the community of Chichester and staff at the school.
The school governors work with the Headteacher and are responsible for setting the strategic direction of the school.
If you are interested in becoming a school governor, please speak to the Headteacher to find out about any vacancies.
The Governing Body consists of 12 members and operates with 3 committees.
Ian Lomax, Co-Chair of Governors
Clare Few, Co-Chair of Governors

Wrap Around Care
Before-school and after-school care
At Jessie Younghusband Primary School, we understand the importance of providing quality wraparound care for our families. We are pleased to partner with two local providers to offer comprehensive services that cater to the needs of our children.
CC's Wraparound ServiceCC's provides a full wraparound service, including a morning breakfast provision on-site at Jessie Younghusband. After school, they offer care with a meal provided, running from Bishop Luffa School. Children are safely transported from our site to Bishop Luffa, where parents can collect them.
To enquire for more information or to book a space, please follow this link.
Activ8 MindsActiv8 Minds offers a variety of after school clubs suitable for all children, running every day of the week. They provide a flexible booking system with pick-up times at either 4:30 PM or 6:00 PM, ensuring that parents have options that fit their schedules.
To enquire for more information or to book a space, please follow this link.
In addition to these providers, we also have other before and after school clubs available. For more information about those currently on offer, please visit our clubs page.
We are committed to supporting our families and providing enriching experiences for our children!
